The main-level bedroom includes a walk-in closet, en-suite bath, and private patio access. Lower-level bedroom has its own en-suite bath and direct backyard access. Attached one-car garage parking included. Desirable California Street location near shops, restaurants, parks, and public transportation. Beautiful furnished second floor bedroom with renovated en suite bathroom. Hardwood floors, lots of natural light. Bedroom furnished with full size bed, leaning desk/bookshelf with comfortable chair, dresser, nightstand, and lamps.
House has central air, laundry on first floor. Shared use of beautiful kitchen, backyard/patio with grill, and rooftop deck.
Those into wellness will appreciate the low-EMF near infrared sauna, air purifiers, purified drinking water, filtered bathing water, nontoxic cleaning products, and ethernet cords.
Prime location in the East Village of Georgetown, right off of Embassy Row. Five blocks from the Dupont Circle Metro Station. Ten blocks from the Foggy Bottom/GWU Metro Station.
Around the corner from Streets Market, Housebar Georgetown, Apéro, Rose Park Farmers’ Market (Wednesdays May-Oct), and an entrance to Rock Creek Pkwy Trail.
Flexible lease terms. Available immediately.
Widowed realtor with a Yorki looking to rent a furnished room in my home Located in Sun City, 99th & Beardsley. Room has queen bed, desk & chair, storage cabinet and walk - in closet. All utilities are included. Kitchen privliges. Quite individual only. No pets $650.00

Step into the timeless character of a classic San Francisco apartment with the comfort of thoughtful modern updates. Located at 1850 Sacramento Street, this beautifully updated home blends the architectural details people love about San Francisco with a fresh, inviting feel.

This spacious 3-bedroom, 1-bath residence combines memorable views, classic San Francisco character, and modern everyday conveniences. Tall ceilings, fresh paint, attractive light fixtures, and new flooring throughout create a bright, polished, move-in-ready feel.
The updated kitchen features premium stainless-steel appliances and offers a stylish setting for everyday cooking and entertaining. The view-facing living and dining areas, complemented by a fireplace, provide an exceptional backdrop for working from home, hosting friends, or unwinding as the light changes over the Bay.
Step outside to the private outdoor deck for morning coffee, sunset drinks, fresh air, or a quiet moment above the city. An in-unit washer and dryer adds the everyday convenience that is so hard to find in San Francisco.
PLEASE LEAVE YOUR PHONE NUMBER and tell me a little about yourself, and I'll get back to you as soon as possible.

Step into comfortable San Francisco living at 1433 Clay Street, Unit 15, a bright and spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence situated right in the vibrant center of Nob Hill. Seamlessly blending classic architectural charm with everyday convenience, this light-filled home features soaring high ceilings, elegant period details, and three well-proportioned bedrooms ideal for flexible living. Modern updates include two full bathrooms and the ultimate city luxury: an in-unit washer and dryer. Located just moments from Trader Joe’s, Polk Street dining, and easy transit to the Financial District, this pet-friendly home offers an exceptional urban lifestyle in a classic, walkable neighborhood.
Drop your phone number, and we'll contact you soon.

A charming 6-unit building in Lower Pacific Heights. Nestled on a tree-lined street among classic San Francisco homes, this top-floor residence is filled with natural light, vaulted ceilings, and architectural details including exposed brick and skylights. The chef's kitchen is fully equipped with a Viking range, Sub-Zero fridge, Bosch dishwasher, wine fridge, green soapstone counters, and custom cabinetry. Additional features include in-unit laundry, hardwood floors, recessed lighting, dual-paned windows, custom closets, fresh paint, and custom roman shades throughout. The layout offers great separation between bedrooms and entertaining spaces, plus a den and formal dining area. Enjoy outdoor living with a private-use deck with gas BBQ hookup and access to a shared yard. Conveniently located near Alta Plaza Park, Fillmore & Divisadero corridors, California & Geary Streets, and close to Laurel Heights and the Presidio.

Beautifully remodeled 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath single-story home offering approximately 2,190 sq. ft. in a quiet private court in Westside Alamo. Features exceptional indoor-outdoor living and a resort-style backyard, with convenient access to the Iron Horse Trail.
Drop your phone number, and we'll contact you soon.

3418 Divisadero Street is a beautifully updated full-floor flat located in the heart of San Francisco's Marina District. This bright and spacious home blends classic charm with modern updates, featuring hardwood floors throughout, a generous open floor plan, and large windows that flood the space with natural light. The living room offers a decorative fireplace and flows seamlessly into a spacious dining area, perfect for entertaining. The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and ample cabinet space. Both bedrooms are generously sized and tucked away from the street for added privacy, and the sleek, modern bathroom includes a large vanity and a shower-over-tub. Additional features include in-unit laundry, abundant closet space, and a private one-car garage with interior access an exceptional amenity in this neighborhood.
Drop your phone number, and we'll contact you soon.

Grand 1919 pre-war residences in a central San Francisco location, one block from Whole Foods, Lafayette Park, and Van Ness Avenue. Spacious 3-bedroom homes feature separate living and dining rooms, wood-burning fireplace, two full bathrooms, large kitchen with gas range, microwave, refrigerator, disposal, and abundant storage. In-unit laundry and private storage included. Elevator, secure entry, landscaped yard, and onsite manager. Parking may be available.
Drop your phone number, and we'll contact you soon.

This spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers a peaceful retreat within the landscaped grounds of St. Francis Square, conveniently located near Fillmore, Japantown, and Lower Pacific Heights. Hardwood floors, abundant natural light, two full bathrooms, and a well-equipped galley kitchen create a comfortable and functional living space. Enjoy a private outdoor patio, shared laundry nearby, and the rare convenience of an assigned secure garage parking space. Water, garbage, gas, and electricity are included, while the pet-friendly home provides an excellent blend of space, convenience, and tranquil city living.
If you're interested, send me your phone number.

One room available September 1 (or sooner) in East Watertown in a sunny, spacious 4br/2ba house. Rent is $625 per month, plus utilities (electricity, gas, and wifi, totaling about $75-100 per month per person). Security deposit ($500) and last month's rent ($625) are required up front as well. You'd be signing on to the new lease from 9/1/2026-8/31/2027, but subletting has never been a problem in the past if you need more flexibility.
The apartment consists of the top two floors of a 3-story house. The available room is about 120 sq ft, plus a deep closet. It is painted a nice light grey. There is room for a full size bed, dresser, and desk, with space to move around. Dresser and desk available for free if desired. The two windows get nice light since it's on the top (3rd) floor of the house. Also on the 3rd floor is one other bedroom, the full bathroom the two rooms share, and a bonus space down the hall.
The rest of the apartment is on the 2nd floor of the house, including a fully equipped kitchen (no dishwasher, sadly), a breakfast nook/pantry, dining room, living room, screened front porch, and back porch with Boston skyline views. The other two bedrooms and the bathroom they share are also on the 2nd floor. The house is fully furnished and there is some storage space available. Washer and dryer in the basement are shared with the first-floor neighbors, and available for normal usage (i.e. weekly, not daily).
Convenient location near the Cambridge / Belmont / Watertown border. It's a 5 min. walk to either of the very frequent 71 or 73 MBTA buses. Harvard Square is under 20 min. door-to-door by bus or bike, and from Harvard you can get on the Red Line and access the rest of Cambridge, downtown Boston, and beyond. There is a driveway for free off-street tandem parking during the winter, but many/most people have happily lived here without a car. The immediate neighborhood is nice and very quiet, but anything you'd need is available within walking distance.
Looking for a non-smoking, friendly, responsible adult who unfailingly pays rent and utilities on time and doesn't require a chore chart to pick up after yourself and keep common spaces clean. Over the years, some housemates have become close friends and some have been acquaintances whose busy schedules mean they aren't around much; anywhere in that range is fine as long as you're considerate, low-drama, and experienced in peaceable coexistence with others.
This is a really great deal for the area and especially for the amount of space. There is no catch, except that most of the apartment hasn't been updated in this millennium and definitely has its quirks. Our house has good bones and a lot of sunlight and charm, but is showing its age in places, so if you're looking for sleek and ultra-modern, this ain't it!
IMPORTANT: Please write to chrisadam1977k(AtGmailcom) something about yourself such as what you do, why you are moving, and what you're looking for in a shared living space, as well as a couple times that would work for you to see the place. If it sounds like a potentially good fit we'll contact you to set up a time.

Spacious 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath apartment in San Francisco’s Marina District. Features a flexible layout with plenty of living space and an in-unit washer and dryer. Conveniently located near neighborhood shops, restaurants, cafes, and the waterfront. One-year lease. Cats and small dogs welcome, subject to property guidelines. No parking available. Tenant responsible for utilities.
Let us reach out by sharing your phone number.

Experience exceptional San Francisco living from this stunning 3-bedroom home perched directly on the historic Broadway Steps. Enjoy breathtaking, unobstructed views of Coit Tower, the Bay Bridge, and the Transamerica Pyramid, with abundant natural light throughout the multi-level layout. The home features one private ensuite bedroom, two additional bedrooms with a shared full bathroom, and a dedicated in-unit laundry area. Located in the heart of walkable Russian Hill, with convenient street parking typically available nearby. No smoking; tenants are responsible for all utilities. Please leave your name, phone number, preferred move-in date, and a little about yourself for a faster response

Most sought after location in the Marina! Just a short distance to the Chestnut Street shops in one direction and the Marina Green in the other. Formal entry, foyer, living room with fireplace and dining room all with much of the original detail preserved. Gleaming hardwood floor and charming French doors, two large bedrooms with attached sunroom overlooking the garden. Fabulous light streams through newer double pane window from all directions producing a lovely warm feeling in each and every room of this beautiful home. A supersized updated kitchen with breakfast area, features a gas range, custom cabinetry and a lovely original built in sideboard/storage cabinet. A split bath with shower over deep tub completes this upper level. Stunning fully renovated 3 bedroom, 1-bath Victorian flat offering approximately 1,440 sq ft in a secure gated 3-unit building dating to 1886. This condo-quality home features 11-foot ceilings, hardwood and stone floors, central heating, decorative fireplace, custom kitchen with granite counters and island, stainless steel appliances, and CAT 6 wiring throughout. Enjoy a luxurious spa bathroom with Jacuzzi and custom vanities, primary suite with walk-in closet, decorative skylight, and private outdoor deck. Prime Hayes Valley location near Civic Center, Alamo Square, and major tech employers. Please leave your name, phone number, preferred move-in date, and a little about yourself for a faster response

Beautifully Remodeled Large 3 Bedrooms two bathrooms, Deck off two of the bedrooms and beautiful stairs to landscaped backyard. Grow your own herbs or flowers.
Beautifully and remodeled, this spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers approximately 1,500 sq. ft. of comfortable living space in a highly desirable Richmond neighborhood.
The unit features a bright and spacious floor plan with modern finishes throughout. Two of the bedrooms have direct access to the outdoor area, with a staircase leading to a landscaped backyard—a wonderful bonus for relaxing and enjoying some private outdoor space.
Property Features:
3 spacious bedrooms
2 fully remodeled bathrooms
Approximately 1,500 sq. ft. of living space
Completely remodeled throughout
Direct outdoor access from two bedrooms
Staircase leading to landscaped backyard
One-car garage parking included
Convenient location near shops, restaurants, schools, and neighborhood amenities
Less than half a block to public transportation with convenient service to Downtown and the Financial District
Walking distance to the San Francisco VA Medical Center
Located near highly regarded elementary and high schools
Available for immediate occupancy
This is an excellent opportunity for anyone looking for a large, beautifully remodeled 3-bedroom home with parking and outdoor space in a convenient San Francisco location.

2262 Filbert Street, San Francisco, CA 94123
Beautifully remodeled top-floor 5-room Victorian flat in the heart of Cow Hollow, one of San Francisco’s most desirable and walkable neighborhoods. Occupying the top floor of an intimate 3-flat Victorian building, this spacious residence combines classic San Francisco character with extensive modern updates. The top-floor location provides excellent natural light, privacy, and a wonderful residential feel.
Property Highlights:
•	Top-floor 5-room Victorian flat
•	Newly remodeled throughout
•	Beautiful hardwood floors
•	High ceilings and abundant natural light
•	Classic Victorian architectural details
•	Spacious formal living room
•	Separate formal dining room
•	Flexible rooms for bedrooms, home office, or guest room
•	Remodeled bathroom
•	Updated kitchen with new appliances
•	In-unit washer and dryer
•	Recessed lighting and modern finishes
•	Excellent Cow Hollow location
•	Near Union Street, Chestnut Street, Marina District, restaurants, cafés, shopping, parks, and public transportation
•	Street parking only — no garage parking included
Rent: $8,295 per month
Term: 12 months lease
Deposit: $8,295.00
Enjoy the charm and generous proportions of a classic San Francisco Victorian with the comfort of a newly remodeled interior. The flexible 5-room floor plan is ideal for those looking for additional space for working from home, entertaining, or creating a comfortable guest room.
Available for private showing by appointment. Serious and qualified applicants are welcome to inquire for additional information and to schedule a tour. View the video here: https://bayarealeasingagent.com/rentals/2262filbert.mp4

This unique full-floor flat is part of a small historic building designed by Julia Morgan in the best neighborhood steps away from Fillmore and Divisadero Streets. Enter the gated front yard and find a peaceful outdoor space hidden in the City's best neighborhood. Hand-carved woodwork, 11' ceilings and other charming features from 140 years ago were retained while the home was updated for current living with new cabinets, counters, appliances, Ann Sacks tile, Jonathan Adler Lighting, full size in-unit laundry machines, intercom, allergen-free radiant heating (no banging radiators) and high-speed Sonic fiber internet. There is lots of light from all four sides because of the detached building.  The home has its own private entrance, room for bike storage, security cameras and a secure area for packages. The apartment can be used as a 2 or 3 bedroom unit depending on if the dining room and office are used as bedrooms. There is room for desks in each bedroom and a dining area in the living room. There are 2 full bathrooms.
Street parking is easy on this block with a $215 annual permit.  Walk 1-2 flat blocks to Alta Plaza Park, Mollie Stone Grocery, B Patisserie, Routier, Pizzeria Delfina, Tailor's Son, Florio or Sweet Maple.  Japantown and the Presidio are a short walk away.  The owner lives on-site and is available as needs arise. Available for 12 months or more. The express 1 California bus line is 1/2 block away and Lyft cars are easy to get at all hours. If you'd like to see the apartment, please say when you are available.  Photos show the home when it was staged.

Entering through a gracious fr entry foyer, you are greeted by an elegant formal living room featuring a wood-burning fireplace, hardwood floors, built-ins, and arched windows opening onto a Juliet balcony. Adjacent is a sophisticated formal dining room opening to an expansive back deck, allowing for seamless indoor/outdoor entertaining. The heart of the home is the lovely chef's kitchen, boasting a center island for informal dining, a butler's pantry, Cambria quartz countertops, deluxe appliances, and an inviting breakfast area overlooking the deck. Also on this level is a convenient laundry room and a powder room. Ascending the skylit landing, discover 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 baths on the upper level. The primary suite is outfitted with corner windows, 2 walk-in closets, and a bathroom with a separate shower and tub. The 2nd and 3rd bedrooms share a Jack & Jill bathroom with a shower. One-car garage and two large, windowed storage rooms are on the lower level, with the potential for expansion. Conveniently located just blocks from Sacramento St shops & dining, Laurel Village, the Presidio, playgrounds, and more. Enjoy the perfect blend of timeless charm and modern amenities in a fabulous neighborhood.

Located on the sunny south side of Bernal Hill, this single family home in Bernal Heights is close to the commercial heart of Bernal. Steps from Martha's Coffee, Good Life Grocery, restaurants, bars and convenience stores.
Easy access to both 101 and 280 freeways, and close to the 24 Divisadero and 14 Mission bus lines, and the 67 bus line that serves the Mission District BART station, this is one of the most accessible neighborhoods in San Francisco. Bernal Hill park has 360-degree city views, and the more wooded Holly Park is a sheltered and pleasant park for relaxation.
Recently remodeled, the kitchen has Bosch appliances and kitchen and both bathrooms are fitted with Grohe fixtures. The basement/garage has a washer and dryer, tall freezer and houses garbage, recycling and compost bins for weekly collection.
The back yard is paved, and is overlooked by two redwood decks. Please leave your name, phone number, preferred move-in date, and a little about yourself for a faster response

This full-floor flat, located in a historic building by Julia Morgan near Fillmore and Divisadero Streets, combines vintage charm with modern amenities. It features hand-carved woodwork, 11' ceilings, and has been updated with new appliances, radiant heating, high-speed internet, and more. The sunlit space includes a private entrance, bike storage, security cameras, and options for 2-3 bedrooms. It also has 2 full bathrooms, accommodating both work and living needs.
Please leave your name, phone number, preferred move-in date, and a little about yourself for a faster response

Welcome to a tranquil 3-bedroom, 2-bath home in St. Francis Square, situated between Fillmore, Japantown, and Lower Pacific Heights. This approximately 1,050-square-foot residence features hardwood floors, abundant natural light, and cross ventilation. Each bedroom can serve as a comfortable space for living or working. The galley kitchen includes original hardwood cabinetry, ample storage, and modern appliances. A private patio offers outdoor relaxation, and shared laundry is located nearby. Monthly rent covers water, garbage, gas, electricity, and one secure garage space, making this home a unique opportunity for city dwellers seeking comfort and convenience.

You do not want to miss this beautiful total remodeled single family home. Small but absolute charming with all contemporary features. Tucked away at the rear of the property for ultimate privacy, this beautifully reimagined detached cottage offers a rare oasis in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods, this hidden gem combines modern luxury with serene outdoor living.    Thoughtfully remodeled from top to bottom . The home features three spacious bedrooms and three full bathrooms across two levels. Every detail has been updated, including new electrical systems, a new furnace, designer bathrooms, and a stunning kitchen equipped with brand-new appliances.    The true showpiece is the spectacular professionally landscaped backyard. Lush gardens, inviting gathering spaces, and mature plantings create a private retreat so captivating that it rivals the beauty of the home itself.
Perfectly positioned just approximately 40 feet from Geary Blvd.,  residents enjoy unparalleled access to public transportation with convenient service to down San Francisco, the Financial District, and beyond.
